name: ty-lsp
description: Runs `ty server` from the checkout's own .venv as the Python language server, so per-edit diagnostics come from the same `ty` that `just typecheck` and CI run. Resolved through ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, so a session started inside a worktree uses that worktree's venv; a mid-session worktree switch keeps the launch checkout's binary, because CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR does not follow the switch.
